about.title: About
about.lead: I'm a full-stack software engineer focused on turning business problems into robust systems.
paragraphs: My approach goes beyond stacking frameworks: I work from software architecture design and cloud infrastructure provisioning all the way to delivering fluid, accessible interfaces.

With my Bachelor's in Computer Science, completed in March 2026, I have a solid foundation in systems design, algorithms and best practices. I work with modern ecosystems (React, Next.js, Node.js, Spring Boot) and advanced content management (Hygraph, WordPress), always prioritizing what really matters in production: security, scalability, automated testing and real observability.

cards.title: SaaS & Complete Ecosystems
cards.desc: Building multi-tenant platforms from scratch, integrating payment gateways (Stripe), access control (RBAC) and CMS-based architectures (WordPress, Hygraph) for dynamic content management.

cards.title: Architecture & Back-end
cards.desc: Building resilient APIs (REST/GraphQL), microservices, messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ) and database modeling.

cards.title: Front-end & Immersive Experiences
cards.desc: Crafting rich, pixel-perfect and accessible interfaces with React and Next.js. Advanced animations and 3D with Three.js, GSAP and Motion, with a strict focus on Core Web Vitals.

projects.title: Featured work

osm.title: oSeuMáximo
osm.tagline: An education SaaS ecosystem, in production
osm.overview: I architected and built a complete multi-app system in production: a central back-end serving three front-ends, with multi-tenant SSO across several brands, billing, queues and end-to-end test coverage.

platform.desc: NestJS + Fastify core with Clean Architecture: PostgreSQL + Redis, Prisma, JWT auth (jose) + Argon2, multi-tenant SSO, billing and queues (BullMQ). 56 suites / 691 tests, structured logging, Sentry and Swagger.

app.desc: Study app at oseumaximo.com: React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Zustand and Stripe.js checkout.

admin.desc: Internal admin panel with role-based access control (ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN): React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind v4, TanStack Query and Zustand.

prof.desc: Live-class scheduler at oseuprof.com: React 19, Vite, shadcn/ui, framer-motion, Zod + react-hook-form, Vitest + Cypress.
